properties.note: Pre-reaction complex HN=NH...C2H4 (both N-H hydrogens pointing at the two alkene carbons; N-N 1.221, N1-H3 1.068, C=C 1.346, H...C 2.043 A). B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest 133.5 cm-1).
Six-membered cyclic concerted H-transfer saddle; one imaginary frequency -446.59 cm-1 aligned with the H3-C5/H4-C6 forming pairs. N1-N2 1.197, N1-H3 1.130, C5-C6 1.371, H3...C5 = H4...C6 1.689 A.

Product state N2 + ethane. The N2...C2H6 contact pair has no clean minimum at B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (every stationary point is a flat librational saddle, one imaginary mode -25.0 or -4.9 cm-1), so the frequency-verified minimum evidence is per component: components/n2_optfreq.log (one real mode, 2490.4 cm-1, E = -109.439973699 Ha) and components/ethane_optfreq.log (18 real modes, lowest 318.5 cm-1, E = -79.7770351284 Ha). The declared whole-complex energy is that of the normally terminated product-complex log delivered for this node.
